remarks_1999: Not recorded Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive in 1970 indicates [by Lloyd Goodrich], "Doris Bry showed me 2 color transparencies of this, 4/6/70. She said it was painted in 1970, and is 20 x 17, oil on canvas, In the transparency it looks stunning. A black rock against a strong tight blue background, like the sky. From the transparency, xxx. To be included in WM [Whitney Museum] ex." See cat. nos. 1485, 1517–22. Backing inscription 2 may indicate preparatory work. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
